rationale: The Route-B region universe is GRCh38.
ENCODE identifies this file as the preferred default GRCh38 blacklist resource.
ENCODE ATAC-seq processing documents blacklist filtering as part of peak processing.
The decision is frozen before inspecting any real Route-B consensus-peak result or Route-A/B agreement.
execution_rule: download the accession by immutable ENCODE file identity
pass the verified BED explicitly to pycisTopic get_consensus_peaks path_to_blacklist
record pre-filter and post-filter region counts and blacklist-overlap attrition
do not change blacklist resource based on Route-A/B agreement
failure_policy: If the downloaded bytes do not match the pinned ENCODE MD5, fail closed and do not build the Route-B consensus universe.
scientific_scope: Blacklist exclusion is a prospective artifact-control decision, not a biological filter and not a tuning parameter.
